name: Mile mountain
summary: Two friends training for the same race climb one drawn mountain, one switchback trail each: every logged run moves your face up your trail past the long-run flags, race day is the summit, and whoever's ahead can send the one behind a gentle 'Sat long run?' from the trail.
useWhen: we signed up for the eastfield half, keep each other honest
marathon training buddy tracker for me and arun
how far behind am i lol
dontUseWhen: a group fitness streak with more than two people (use gym)
a one-off race-day plan or ride
betting on who finishes faster (use handshake-bet)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Road to the Eastfield half'

race.description: Race day shown at the summit, e.g. 'Sun Apr 12'

goal.description: Plan miles from the foot to the summit, 5 to 2000

runners.description: The two runners, left trail first

note.description: Their last log, in their words

flags.description: Long runs flagged on both trails, up to six

miles.description: Total-miles mark where the flag stands

nudge.description: The gentle nudge the one ahead can send, e.g. 'Sat long run?'

nudged.description: Who already got the nudge (must be the one behind by 5 miles or more), or empty
